title: Three interchangeable cuffs on integral studs
status: Local TPU/stud fit approved; full jaws and loaded phone retention unvalidated

bom.name: Rigid shaft clamp cap
bom.note: Taller cap walls meet the flat fixed jaw across a 1 mm split gap; inner extent X-4.8. Slot end ligaments thickened 1.6 to 2.6 mm; slot width 8.8 mm unchanged. 110 mm collar spans Z-40..70; two screws on each axial side of the jaw at Z-30/+60. Entire outer side at X12: body, crossing, rail wings and four screw seats share one bed plane. Use 1.8 mm shorter collar screws and the extended bracket bearing plate. New full collar fit and loaded retention unvalidated.

bom.name: Centered fixed stud, sliding track and shaft saddle
bom.note: Flat collar underside at X-5.8 with approved ramp below the fixed band hook; guide-floor slot with35-degree roof. Four screw mounts, track edges/stops and centered cuff unchanged. Matches the approved PETG plate geometry; physical strength and retention unqualified.

bom.name: Sliding dual-stud jaw
bom.note: Two fins end flush with the fixed rails at Y +/-13.8 mm, with 0.4 mm top clearance; wraparound skirts removed. Two 31 x 4 mm beam openings with 3.8 mm edge rails. Continuous121.6 mm beam flush with central root at X-10/-2. Studs100 mm apart; jaw sits5.2 mm farther out to keep cuff contacts unchanged. Tongue design retained; engagement and band preload need physical checks. See flush-beam slice.

bom.name: Interchangeable 21.6 mm TPU cuff
bom.note: One unchanged shape at all three contacts: 6.8 mm square passage, 9.6 x 6.8 mm head recess. Integral seating ribs. ELEGOO TPU95A; previous square-stud fit successful, new ramped-stud pull-out resistance and full phone grip unqualified.

bom.name: Flat-back plunger frame and offset rail bracket
bom.note: Smoothly blended reinforcement. Mount bore offset 4.4 mm for a common flat back, preserving 5.4 mm beside the bore. No rail locating lugs: one screw/nut clamps the flat face; friction alone resists sliding and rotation. Bearing plate extends inward 1.8 mm to the flat cap; phone/plunger positions and rail fasteners unchanged. Remove phone/release twine; loosen nut and slide module with captured fasteners to rail screw Y +50 near / -50 far. Remove nut/screw there, withdraw 4.5 mm, lower 2 mm, then withdraw. Strength and retention unqualified.

bom.name: Rounded-shoe sliding plunger
bom.note: Shoe and blended root share the stem thickness of 4 mm; contact span remains 16 mm. Shared capped band/twine cleat. Nominal stroke is illustrative, not a physical force limit.

bom.name: Deep-groove redirect pulley
bom.note: Groove depth 1.1 to 2.2 mm nominal, with 36-degree flanks. Same 18 mm diameter, 4 mm width and 8.6 mm bore; unchanged axle and bearing envelope. Minimum radial web 2.5 mm. PETG slice review required; physical string retention, strength and rotation untested.

bom.name: Headed smooth pulley axle
bom.note: Unchanged 20.6 mm overall span, 8 mm shaft and outboard cross-key. Now supported by one 8.2 mm boss; head retains the wheel. Cantilever loading and new stack clearance require physical testing.

bom.name: TPU T/V axle snap key
bom.note: T-head stop and split V tip;14.7 mm overall,3 mm stem/thickness,5 mm relaxed V span. Pinch arms for removal. Snap insertion, pull-out, wear and creep untested; keeper band retained pending qualification. Cuffs use integral studs.

bom.name: Common long TPU screw
bom.note: One unchanged 30.2 mm threaded-span 8×3 design: four collar screws and one actuator rail screw. Rail screw projects 12.2 mm farther beyond its nut; head bearing stays unchanged. User selects TPU for tighter feel; loaded retention, creep and thread strength unverified.

bom.name: Common TPU clamp nut
bom.note: Same 8×3 nut geometry at all five stations. ELEGOO TPU 95A selected by user for tighter feel; hand-tighten only. Sustained preload, creep and thread stripping remain untested.

bom.name: Reversible TPU clip guide
bom.note: Single offset 4 mm eye, half the former diameter. 6 mm axial width; 1.6 mm walls around a 13.8 x 18.8 mm opening and 13 mm snap mouth. Flip end-for-end for left/right eye. No guide bands, grooves or lower guides. Snap fit, sliding retention, cord friction and creep untested.

bom.name: Twine sections joined by inline band
bom.note: Two lengths joined with a rubber band along the neck. Run directly from the pulley to the nearest shaft guide; there are no bracket guide holes; leave enough for knots. Cord-clearance checks use the provisional 2 mm diameter; actual twine, knots and larger diameters need qualification.

bom.name: Rubber bands
bom.note: 2 jaw closing + 1 return + 1 inline overtravel + 1 axle-key keeper. Actual preload and loop count need fitting.
